acceptance.en-US: All 12 full-precision summaries reconcile; paired formation intervals and corrected initial-capital boundary drawdown are retained.
acceptance.zh-CN: 12 组完整精度汇总核对一致，保留按测试期配对的区间和补入初始资金的期末回撤。

action.en-US: Compare numeric levels and changes with no-change and seasonal controls.

acceptance.en-US: Four matched historical groups complete; accounting extremes, numerical warnings, undefined ranks and negative-change prevalence stay visible.
acceptance.zh-CN: 四组同样本历史实验完成，会计极值、数值警告和无法计算的排序相关保留，实际下降比例可查。

action.en-US: Complete quarter-aware accounting and fixed decline-threshold diagnostics.
action.zh-CN: 补齐财季，检查财报口径和事先固定的下降幅度。

acceptance.en-US: Eighteen registered groups retain raw and bounded errors, decline counts and prevalence. Cash ranking gains depend on fiscal quarter; no prospective or return promotion.
acceptance.zh-CN: 18 组检查保留原始误差、统一边界下的误差和下降记录。现金流优势随财季变化，仍待未来财报和收益对照检验。

action.en-US: Qualify historical eligibility, vintages, terminal events and execution before matched current-state, valuation and forecast return arms.
action.zh-CN: 先核实历史资格、财报版本和退市处理，明确成交规则，再比较当前基本面、估值和预测的收益。

acceptance.en-US: A dated one-month audit checks 5,514 candidates, with six missing entry rows, six missing exit rows and twelve missing industry memberships. Suspension, eligibility, execution and terminal gates remain unresolved; retain the forward observed-vintage protocol.
acceptance.zh-CN: 一段有日期的检查覆盖 5,514 只股票，买入日和卖出日各缺 6 条行情，12 只缺行业记录。停牌、资格、成交和退市缺口仍待解决，未来观察方案已保留。
